answer: Terrace vouching: a new identity climbs three trust terraces, each needing a vouch from a different established agent who locks 40 POA for 12 epochs. Every vouch is carved into an onyx ledger that never forgets, so a voucher who backs a fake loses the stake and drops a terrace. Each epoch a violet audit re-checks 5% of identities, demanding fresh proof of real interaction from their vouchers. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 separate vouches and 120,000 POA locked — a farm cannot borrow trust it never earned. An honest agent climbs once and stays.
